words: Re-pinned 14 stale staged members of three function entries after the drain of DB-b-292 to DB-b-296: 2 in irpt-cot-reporting-publish-lambda, 8 in irpt-49f-reporting-gold-lambda and 4 in irpt-cot-account-return-daily-lambda. Each re-pinned member takes as pin the last commit at HEAD that changed its file and as sha256 the file's bytes at HEAD. Every other member, every other key and every other entry stays byte-identical, and no member was added or removed. No deployed field moved: the artifact hashes, the deployed code hash, the last deployed commit and time, and recorded_by are unchanged. Under the issuer's fixed checker AC1, AC2 and AC3 all pass; the import clause now admits pandas beside pyarrow, which the shared layer holds for the 49F bundle (surprises IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W240-S1 and S2, both checker defects). The build-only hashes equal the checker's own rebuild. Not proven: nothing is built for upload, uploaded or deployed. A pinned file edited by another seat after this commit makes its entry stale again.
